root_idea.summary: The root centers on pouring or flowing forth, especially in abundance.
root_idea.development: The basic notion of pouring extends to abundant water, torrents, sacrificial blood, and figurative copiousness in bounty or speech.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized adjective citation form ثَجَّاج.

senses.definition: Pouring forth abundantly; copious in its outpouring.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, it qualifies water and describes water pouring down in great abundance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To flow or pour forth vehemently or abundantly; also to flow abundantly as the blood of a sacrificial victim.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form I usage, applied to water and, in sacrificial usage, to the blood of a victim.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make water or blood flow; to pour it forth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive Form I usage, including the pouring of sacrificial blood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Abundant flowing of milk into a receptacle in a milking expression.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the construction حَلَبَ فِيهِ ثَجًّا, describing milk abundantly entering the vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A source yielding an abundance of water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal description of a water source characterized by copious supply.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A torrent or forceful flow of water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a noun for a strong flow or torrent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sound produced by water pouring forth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct nominal use referring to the sound of flowing or poured water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Copiously pouring or flowing; applied to rain, blood, or a cloud, as well as to abundant liquid more generally.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These broader Classical applications extend the adjective beyond its Quranic occurrence, which specifically describes water.
Figurative usage describing a person through imagery of a copiously pouring rain or a copious sea.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An eloquent or able speaker whose words pour forth copiously.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative usage applied to a speaker or orator.
